plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 6 lesional vs 6 control skin samples (unpaired, single batch, raw salmon gene-level counts, 12000 genes). Sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median — per the sourced rule this is inspected and reported, not silently dropped. The pipeline: (1) sample-structure QC (library sizes, PCA/sample-distance heatmap on a variance-stabilized-like transform) to visualize where sample_01 falls and decide/justify inclusion; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smaller group size); (3) PyDESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization internal to the model; (4) explicit reference-level design (control as reference, contrast = lesional vs control); (5) Wald test; (6) apeglm-style LFC shrinkage for reporting/ranking, keeping unshrunken LFC+SE alongside; (7) BH-adjusted p-values with independent filtering at alpha=0.05, gene selected by padj not raw p or FC alone; (8) preranked GSEA (gseapy) on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (2026.1, human, 50 sets), with Reactome as a secondary/follow-up collection; (9) a report step consolidating DE table, diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion/mean-variance), enrichment table with leading-edge genes, and full reproducibility record (versions, seed, collection versions). All scripting is Python per user constraint (PyDESeq2 for DE, gseapy for enrichment) — no R steps.
